mapper.select: SELECT um.user_membership_id AS userMembershipId, um.user_id AS userId, um.membership_id AS membershipId, um.start_date AS startDate, um.end_date AS endDate, um.status AS status, um.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, m.name AS name, m.price AS price, m.discount_rate AS discountRate, m.description AS description FROM user_membership um INNER JOIN membership m ON um.membership_id = m.membership_id WHERE um.user_id = #{userId} AND um.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED') AND um.end_date >= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY um.user_membership_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_membership (user_id, membership_id, start_date, end_date, status, cancelled_at) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{membershipId}, CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE), CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE), #{status}, CAST(#{cancelledAt} AS TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_membership SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CAST(#{cancelledAt} AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE user_membership_id = #{userMembershipId}
UPDATE user_membership SET status = 'ACTIVE', cancelled_at = NULL WHERE user_membership_id = #{userMembershipId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND payment_status = 'PAID' AND ordered_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_membership WHERE status IN ('ACTIVE', 'CANCELLED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_membership WHERE start_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_membership WHERE status = 'CANCELLED'

SELECT um.user_membership_id AS userMembershipId, um.user_id AS userId, um.membership_id AS membershipId, um.start_date AS startDate, um.end_date AS endDate, um.status AS status, um.cancelled_at AS cancelledAt, u.name AS name FROM user_membership um INNER JOIN users u ON um.user_id = u.user_id WHERE um.status = 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY um.user_membership_id DESC LIMIT 10
